events.title: Investigation assessment
events.detail: Checkout service is failing with HTTP 503, and its failure propagates to storefront and dependent services. The root cause is unconfirmed due to missing origin diagnostics for payments and ledger. Current policies block all recovery actions because origin logs and request traces are unavailable. Historical incident memory indicates that disabling a feature flag on payments resolved a similar issue, but this outcome is not currently applicable due to the absence of diagnostic evidence and the lack of current deployment or configuration context. Without origin logs and request traces, no action—rollback, disable feature flag, or restart—can be justified. The full blast radius includes storefront, checkout, payments, and ledger due to dependency chains. The missing diagnostic evidence prevents any evidence-supported recovery action.
